name: CCW-Online ERP
description: Equipment Supplier ERP — Context Control System v2

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qiE "(rm -rf|--force|--no-verify|DROP TABLE|TRUNCATE|git reset --hard)"; then echo "BLOCKED: Destructive command. Use safe alternatives." >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0'
bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qiE "(demo_models\.py|middleware\.ts|demo_auth\.py)"; then echo "BLOCKED: Locked file (demo_models.py, middleware.ts, demo_auth.py)." >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'echo "" >> .claude/PROGRESS.md; echo "## Session end: $(date -Iseconds)" >> .claude/PROGRESS.md; echo "### Modified files:" >> .claude/PROGRESS.md; git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | sed "s/^/- /" >> .claude/PROGRESS.md; git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | sed "s/^/- (staged) /" >> .claude/PROGRESS.md; exit 0'

hooks.prompt: Verify the subagent completed its task: (1) all mentioned files were modified, (2) no partial implementations, (3) type-check passes if code was changed.
